title: What to buy at the Bazar Ramadan when you want to lose weight
intro: The fasting month is no reason for your progress to stop, and it's also not the time to restrict yourself until you're stressed. The Bazar Ramadan is full of tasty food. You can enjoy it all wisely. Focus on protein dishes for buka puasa, and go easy on kuih and sweet drinks. The calories below are estimates for one normal portion.

best.name: 3 dates (kurma)
best.why: A light way to break your fast. Gives quick energy without too many calories.

best.name: 1 piece ayam percik
best.why: Grilled and high in protein. Eat it with rice and ulam at home.

best.name: 1 medium ikan bakar
best.why: High protein, low fat. Dip in air asam, not oily gravy.

best.name: 5 sticks chicken satay + a little sauce
best.why: A buka puasa option that isn't deep-fried. Control the peanut sauce.

best.name: 1 bowl bubur lambuk
best.why: Gentle on the stomach after fasting. Meat and rice in one bowl.

best.name: 1 roll popiah basah
best.why: Lots of vegetables and light. Good as a starter.

careful.name: 1 whole murtabak
careful.why: Packed with oil and egg. Share it with the family or eat half.

careful.name: 1 Roti John
careful.why: Long bread, egg, sauce and mayo. The calories of a full meal or more.

careful.name: 1 large piece ayam goreng berempah
careful.why: Fried with floury spices. Remove the skin to cut a little.

careful.name: 3 pieces sweet kuih (seri muka, talam, kuih lapis)
careful.why: Coconut milk and sugar. One piece is okay, three pieces add up fast.

careful.name: Sugarcane juice or air balang 500ml
careful.why: Feels super refreshing at buka puasa, but high in sugar and not filling.

hacks: Make a list before going to the bazaar: 1 protein dish, 1 vegetable, 1 kuih. Stick to the list.
Break your fast with dates and plain water first. Pray Maghrib, then have your main meal.
Buy the dishes and eat them with rice and vegetables at home. Don't make kuih your dinner.
Buy only one type of kuih each day. Rotate by day so you still get to taste everything.
Ask for 'kurang manis' or 'kurang gula' (less sweet / less sugar). If you buy sugarcane juice, pick a small cup and mix with plain water at home.
drink: Plain water to break your fast, then warm water or teh O kurang manis (less sweet). If you want a bazaar drink, pick a small size or coconut water.

faq.q: Why does my weight go up during the fasting month even though I only eat twice a day?
faq.a: Usually it's because the calories at buka puasa and moreh are high, especially from kuih, fried food and sweet drinks. The number of meals isn't the issue. Try to control the amount and choose protein dishes.

faq.q: What's good for sahur so I don't get hungry fast?
faq.a: Choose protein and fibre: a moderate portion of rice with egg, chicken or fish, vegetables, and enough plain water. Avoid having only sweet kuih and sugary drinks for sahur, because you'll get hungry quickly.
